principles: Do not increase flakiness while fixing validation; keep smoke semantics deterministic
Prefer explicit failures and actionable hints over silent ignores for all reviewer/local verification paths
Keep phase gates consistent by aligning DONE advisory and local verdict evaluators
Avoid modifying fixture baseline behavior unless required by clear evidence
drivers: Multiple validate/TEST failures were burning engineering time due hidden blockers
Review evidence must be mechanically consistent across review_escalation_status and done_prepare
Current regression risk is in lifecycle and review-assurance floor semantics

options.name: Option A: minimal edits in each hotspot
cons: May leave unknown root cause for CHK-001 and mask recurring floor mismatch risks

options.name: Option B: targeted mechanical fixes plus one regression harness update
pros: Closes each CHK path with deterministic evidence and runtime guardrails
Provides fail-fast visibility without masking missing binding/floor issues
Reduces future TEST churn and makes DONE gating behavior explicit
cons: Touches validation and review-evidence surface, needs careful phase-aware testing

chosen: Option B: targeted mechanical fixes plus one regression harness update
rationale: This route closes the remaining blocker paths directly, records explicit evidence for each checklist item, and gives durable protections against future regressions in validate and DONE readiness behavior.

preMortem.scenario: cli-json-stdout-contract-smoke still hangs after command-level timeout changes
preMortem.trigger: subprocess inherits interactive stdin or unresolved dependency
preMortem.consequence: validation remains slow; regression undetected while giving false PASS
preMortem.mitigation: Add targeted command-level timeout and log exact hanging command path for immediate diagnosis before any green assumption

preMortem.scenario: done_prepare reports stale binding mismatch to review_escalation_status
preMortem.trigger: different hash-binding assumptions in floor evaluators
preMortem.consequence: DONE can still block indefinitely even with valid degraded rounds
preMortem.mitigation: Cross-check floor report payload from done_prepare against review_escalation_status and unify binding keys or route text guidance accordingly

preMortem.scenario: global fixture failures are treated as code defects and over-prioritized
preMortem.consequence: unnecessary code churn and extra risk for unrelated behavior
preMortem.mitigation: Run each involved smoke explicitly and record root-cause evidence in checklist instead of speculative code changes
